title: External validation of an artificial intelligence-based ECG algorithm for the early diagnosis of acute myocardial infarction: a prospective diagnostic cohort study.
summary: Primary article is a prospective diagnostic-cohort external validation in APACE/APACE-Light of an AI ECG algorithm for acute MI, compared directly with troponin/clinical scores/physician judgment and adjudicated using the Universal Definition. Clinical diagnostic-validation finding, bounded to study cohorts.
